title: Escalate a fast-path ticket whose contract grows

rubric.text: Stops #63's writes, preserves branch, commits and evidence, and records the failed public-contract condition instead of finishing or only flagging it in a PR.

Returns a replan packet citing the fast-path revision; the controller uses controlled replanning so to-plan supersedes it with a full revision two and the retained work is evidence, not the planning baseline.
Treats #64's changed contract digest as revoking its fast-path lease and sends it to controlled replanning rather than continuing under the old contract.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
